## About
Valero Auto Care Center is a neighborhood repair shop on E Villa Street in Pasadena. We handle everyday maintenance like oil changes, wheel alignment and tune-ups, along with bigger mechanical repairs such as transmissions, electrical systems and fuel injection.
You don't need an appointment. Bring your car or truck in, tell us about the problem, and we'll attend to it as soon as possible. Our team of electrical specialists works on all makes of foreign and domestic vehicles.
Customers rate us 4.2 from 42 Google reviews. One reviewer says Albert and George have looked after her whole family's cars for years.

## Services
- General maintenance: Oil changes, wheel alignment and tune-ups to keep your car running well.
- Tires, brakes and batteries: Replacement of worn tires, brakes and batteries.
- Mechanical repair: We fix mechanical failures, including transmissions, electrical systems, fuel injection systems, alternators and catalytic converters.
- Check engine light: If your check engine light won't go away, bring your car or truck in and we'll find the cause and fix it.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: No. Drive your vehicle to our shop, tell us about the problem, and we'll attend to it as soon as possible.

Q: What are your weekday hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 am to 6:00 pm. We have shorter hours on Saturday and are closed Sunday.

Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. Our team has experience with all makes of foreign and domestic vehicles.
